systems.name: 1.1 Adapt Engine to Top‑Down Dual‑Stick Melee
systems.notes: Our existing beat‑em‑up engine already has 8‑direction movement, collision, camera, and sprite rendering. We need to reconfigure it for top‑down view with right‑stick aiming/melee direction. No ground plane pseudo‑3D — pure 2D top‑down.
tasks: Reconfigure movement to use left stick / WASD for 8‑direction movement (already present)
Map right stick / mouse to set facing direction for melee attacks
Adjust camera to top‑down orthographic view (no depth plane)
Disable pseudo‑3D ground rendering; replace with flat arena background

systems.name: 1.2 Melee Combat & Hit Detection
systems.notes: Leverage existing attack state machine and hitbox system. Add light/heavy attack chains, directional attacks, and hit reactions.
tasks: Implement light attack chain (3‑hit combo) with directional variation
Implement heavy attack (hold or separate button) with knockback
Attach hitboxes to weapon arcs (use existing hitbox system)
Enemy hit‑react animations and knockback
Debug hitbox visualisation toggle (reuse existing debug tools)

systems.name: 1.3 First Unicorn & Basic Abilities
systems.notes: Implement Solaris as the first playable unicorn with 2 weapons (Broad Horn, Piercing Horn) and 2 horn powers. Use existing character/sprite framework.
tasks: Create Solaris character data (stats, placeholder sprite using existing art pipeline)
Implement weapon switching (Broad Horn vs Piercing Horn) — modify attack hitbox shapes
Implement Sunflare horn power (AoE spin, health drain, cooldown)
Implement Twilight Dash horn power (teleport strike, brief invuln)
Cooldown UI and visual feedback (reuse existing HUD system)

systems.name: 1.4 Basic Enemy AI (Tier 1: Aliens)
systems.notes: Create 3 alien enemy types using existing enemy AI framework (state machines, patrol/chase). Grey (melee), Drone (ranged), Tentacle Spawn (tank).
tasks: Grey: fast melee rusher using existing melee enemy template
Drone: ranged burst‑fire projectile, slow movement
Tentacle Spawn: high HP, slow, grab attack (extend AI with grab state)
Wave‑based spawning (hand‑crafted waves via existing wave manager adaptation)

systems.name: 1.5 Single Arena & Wave Progression
systems.notes: Create a single test arena with 5 waves + a mini‑boss placeholder. Win/loss conditions, round management.
tasks: Design arena layout (flat, with obstacle props for visual variety)
Implement wave manager (escalating enemy count and mix)
Mini‑boss encounter (The Vanguard placeholder, single phase)
Victory/defeat screen and restart flow
